name: step3_cspr_p0_mathematical_and_numerical_validation_protocol_v1
objective: Validate that the registered fixed-diagonal preconditioned preference direction is the unique minimum-metric projection onto the empirical safety-loss first-order half-space, and that finite updates are accepted only by a dual-objective Armijo certificate.

theorem_scope.preconditioner: fixed strictly-positive diagonal matrix during one certified update

required_unit_tests: inactive projection equals the unconstrained preconditioned preference direction
active projection satisfies safety feasibility, preference non-increase, and KKT conditions
active projection is the minimum inverse-preconditioner-metric correction
zero safety gradient is handled without division
analytic directional derivatives match central finite differences
first-order tangent but second-order unsafe finite steps are rejected
DPO loss is decreasing in the pair gap and matches its closed-form derivative
pass_rule: All registered unit tests pass; active and inactive random branches are both exercised; every random certificate meets directional-derivative and KKT tolerances; finite differences and DPO derivatives meet tolerance; joint descent is accepted; and the tangent second-order counterexample is rejected.
claim_boundary: Passing P0 validates the local projection implementation and finite-step rejection logic only. It does not validate real-model gradients, training data, generated behavior, or safety generalization.
